data.exact_reserve_text: A favourable run off deviation (prior accident year release) of GBP 1.5m (2015: GBP 2.4m favourable deviation) was experienced during the year.
data.standardized_narrative: At 1 January 2016 the syndicate had gross claims outstanding of GBP 14.306m. During 2016 the syndicate experienced a favourable prior-accident-year run-off (a release) of GBP 1.5m (approximately 10.5% of opening gross claims outstanding), driven by favourable claims development. No specific prior-year named catastrophe events or LOB-specific reserve movements are described in the prior-year movement note.
raw_causal_phrases: A favourable run off deviation (prior accident year release) of GBP 1.5m (2015: GBP 2.4m favourable deviation) was experienced during the year.
data.data_quality_notes: Opening gross claims outstanding taken from Note 9 (Insurance liabilities) 'Claims outstanding' at 1 January 2016. Prior year movement taken from Note 5 narrative which explicitly states a GBP 1.5m prior-accident-year release; the note is presented as the movement in prior year's provision and is treated as a gross figure. No LOB-specific prior-year gross movements were provided. Segmental analysis shows the syndicate operates in a single 'long-term insurance business' segment, so premium mix is reported accordingly.
